reason: Twenty-two thousand, and really twenty-eight with the solar panel because our grid hardly comes, is more than a month and a half of everything we earn. We wash by hand and it costs nothing, so I will not spend that in an ordinary week, and certainly not on a brand nobody in the market has heard of.
objection: I have never heard of this brand. If the battery dies after the warranty, who will fix it in our area, and what will a new battery cost me?
would_change_my_mind: A big Diwali or harvest offer from the dealer I already know, with the solar panel free and a low EMI, plus seeing it work in a neighbour's house first.
